component.name: BMCBL
component.summary: Minecraft Bedrock Edition launcher and version manager

description.p: Better Minecraft Bedrock Launcher manages Minecraft Bedrock Edition versions, downloads, accounts, add-ons and Linux Proton/Wine launchers.
Linux GDK game launching is currently in testing. Xbox achievements and presence are not available for BMCBL-managed non-system-local accounts, and newer game-version cloud saves are unsupported.
